claim_type.caption: Claim Type
claim_type.description: The kind of credential claim the authority evaluated, normalized to the caption of claim_type_id. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

claim_type_id.caption: Claim Type ID
claim_type_id.description: The normalized kind of credential claim the authority evaluated.

1.caption: Connection Credential
1.description: A credential presented on the connection itself, e.g. a mutually-authenticated TLS client certificate.

2.caption: Signed Request Claim
2.description: A claim carried in the request and cryptographically signed by the claimant.

3.caption: Unsigned Request Claim
3.description: A claim carried in the request without a cryptographic signature.

4.caption: Absent
4.description: No claim was presented at all. Distinct from an 'Unproven' decision: a determined absence must be distinguishable from a never-established one.

decision.caption: Decision
decision.description: The authority's verdict on the evaluated claim, normalized to the caption of decision_id. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

decision_id.caption: Decision ID
decision_id.description: The normalized verdict of the authority on the evaluated claim.

2.caption: Unproven
2.description: A claim was presented but the authority could not verify it. Distinct from claim type 'Absent' (no claim at all).

3.caption: Rejected
3.description: The authority rejected the claim. The normalized reason is carried in reason_id; consumers MUST NOT collapse distinct reason_id values.

reason.caption: Reason
reason.description: The normalized reason the claim was rejected, as the caption of reason_id. Populate when decision_id is 'Rejected'; omit otherwise. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

reason_id.caption: Reason ID
reason_id.description: The normalized reason the authority rejected the claim. Required when decision_id is 'Rejected'; absent otherwise. The rejected reasons must not collapse: e.g. an unregistered key (possible attack) and a bad signature (defect or misconfiguration) triage completely differently. An absent accounting_decision means unknown — never 'no decision was made.'

1.caption: rejected:unregistered-key
1.description: The key was never registered — treat as a possible attack.

2.caption: rejected:bad-signature
2.description: The signature failed verification — treat as a defect or misconfiguration.

3.caption: rejected:expired
3.description: The claim or credential had expired.

4.caption: rejected:future-dated
4.description: The claim or credential is dated in the future.

5.caption: rejected:malformed
5.description: The claim or credential could not be parsed.

6.caption: rejected:no-keys-registered
6.description: No keys are registered for the claimed identity at all.

caption: Accounting Decision
description: The verdict of an authority that evaluated an agent identity or credential claim — e.g. whether a presented key was attested, left unproven, or rejected — and, when rejected, the normalized reason. Carries the decision half of the evidence contract: a decision without a reason cannot be audited, only counted.
name: accounting_decision
